description: 100M-word simplification pairs corpus (REBUILT with correct JSON-field-based parsing, no line-index pairing bugs): FineWeb 70M batch + OpenStax/BCCampus fill to reach 100M words

components.source: fineweb_70m_sentences_simplified.jsonl (JSON original/simplified fields, no line-position parsing)

components.note: Overlaps with the OpenStax+BCCampus 10M source condition's simplification data.

fix_note: Previous version of this file was built with a buggy line-index-based pairing script that ignored blank-line separators in the source pairs.txt file, causing most original/simplified pairs to be misaligned. This version reads original/simplified directly from JSON fields, guaranteeing correct alignment.
